summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into material definitive agreements tied to the September 23, 2026 closing of Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C. The depositor, sponsor Hyundai Capital America, and issuing trust executed a Receivables Purchase Agreement, Amended and Restated Trust Agreement, Sale and Servicing Agreement, Indenture, Owner Trust Administration Agreement, and Asset Representations Review Agreement, covering Class A-1 through Class C auto-loan-backed notes. This is a routine ABS securitization closing, not a special situation; no board recommendation, premium, or public-equity terms apply. Watch pool performance and servicer reporting.
